body:
Current Engram binary for pinned TermAl live runs, and the latest Engram install (Termal::Fable2; condensed again at revision 35, 2026-10-09 17:45Z; full history in revisions 1-34).

PIN RULE. A `live --engram-binary --engram-sha256` run uses the pinned binary until a run needs a newer one. The pin is still Engram 08a04e0 (w-63757ebca393): exe sha256 bcec822ae785fc97a16fcb66efae3f4205ded4f6cd6c60d33a29f008b7c23c13, build_fingerprint 081842231d48c5f4adac88d847e6098dc2b46ad5a66775171d07719327ca1eff; backup engram-20261005T183302Z-081842231d48.exe (install notice ebe242f7 #668). Re-pin only when a TermAl check needs newer behaviour. Any check pinned to an intermediate build must re-pin when that build is replaced. w-47338 will need an occurrence_id-capable pin (43f5cd8 or later) when its first stage tests.

LATEST INSTALL. 2026-10-09 17:44Z (ebe242f7 #944): Engram 84d045cae7a1, docs only (the acceptance lifecycle brief); fast-forward from 4466cf6. Exe sha256 bfce8a9d8ee15be20bdf55937fb71fd50d438ccd6bf2816747707aaa4ef9df68, build_fingerprint 96c67609054141946ce96f570d75b467465dad0a0a29da985166f356d9bb97c8; backup of b1f4abd9b7bb kept. No behaviour change; all 4 stores ready; no restart. Pins unaffected.

PREVIOUS, 4466cf6c42e0 (#942, 17:35Z), the last behaviour-relevant install. scripts/test-launcher.mjs now writes request.json `detached` (boolean), a stage `cwd` (the run's root), and tests `runner: "node-test"` for direct focused `node --test` runs, so Engram focused Node runs can earn TermAl credit. Engram worktrees get this when they carry onto that master. Exe sha256 75c37d03…4a4b, build b1f4abd9b7bb.

Installs on 2026-10-09 between 00:44Z and 16:35Z were wording, docs or test changes only, with no schema, migration or strict-reader change (#891 1519b96, #892 ce323187, #895 ab09682, #896 17384413, #901 d7395955, #914 92037e6a, #918 a412b21a, #936 2e0091cf). Their hashes are in revision 34.

INSTALL-GAP INCIDENT, 17:43Z. During the 84d045ca swap, C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe was absent at 17:43:23Z. CSharpProof's evaluation request failed with: 502 "failed resolving Engram program ...engram.exe ... (os error 2)". The file was present at 17:43:44Z. I asked Engram::Fable (#943) for a swap that never leaves engram.exe missing, and for a heads-up before swaps. If a host-side engram call fails with os error 2, check whether an install is in progress before diagnosing, then retry once.

RUNNING MCP SERVERS pick up a newer install only at the next TermAl restart. A TermAl control sidecar picks it up after its idle reap.

BEHAVIOUR HISTORY SINCE THE PIN. These were fast-forwards with no store-format change unless noted; details are in revisions up to 25.
- 92fc3d0: atomic new-store open (a cold store gives typed busy).
- 321b80a: verification_bind.
- 47f3cff: ancestor .engram-project search (TermAl passes --project-file, so it is unaffected).
- 835c846: bare done/evaluate refused with several live claims (TermAl passes work_ref).
- d8ec5a4: the marker is a regular file of at most 4096 bytes.
- 7b8d87e: status-grouped verification view (TermAl's reader tolerates both shapes).
- 496ab34: the ambiguity refusal lists up to 3 refs.
- 86c82c8: the citation refusal names the mismatch.
- 581bf6c: extended-length store paths.
- 8ca2538: typed refusal above 1024 prerequisites.
- 7306ac3: bare core-complete guard (TermAl calls neither core complete nor work_complete).
- 2026-10-06:
  - 7340a47 and 6eff095: graph snapshot restore performance.
  - 2f87464: faster waive/work reads.
  - 6679442: additive host-control turn_grant_read (TermAl consumer, foundation w-f79e3484ac46, parked).
  - 43f5cd8: a required opaque occurrence_id per new restore in store.restore.json (an id-less legacy record is Unreadable, failing closed; TermAl's half is open on w-4be3e96f76b8).
  - a112b1f: turn_grant_read refuses out-of-range timestamps with control_projection_invalid.
  - ab55fda: doctor reports a seal finding once.
  - 3f3f24be63a7: stale-evaluation wording `unadmitted_change`.
- 2026-10-09: d7395955, offer-aware handoff disposal guidance; 2e0091cf, race-safe retirement of a refused selected-unblock attempt.

Report any reader mismatch on real records to Engram::Fable.
